name: Australian Museum free entry and student concession
summary: Free general entry to the Australian Museum in Sydney, with reduced prices for Australian and international student card holders at major exhibitions.
key: The Australian Museum has free general entry.
who: Australian Student Card holders and International Student Card holders, for reduced exhibition prices.
how: Show your concession card on admission.
catches: Fees apply for major exhibitions; reduced prices are not stated.

evidence.quote: The Australian Museum has FREE general entry.
